references.text: The same offerings were given by Nahshon, son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah—a silver plate, a silver bowl, and fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering.
Eliab, son of Helon, from the tribe of Zebulun gave identical offerings—a silver plate weighing 130 shekels and a silver bowl weighing 70 shekels.
Description of plates and bowls made of pure gold for service in the tabernacle.
The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard measure for weighing.
The regulation concerning the grain offering (mincha) of fine flour mixed with oil.
Further instructions about the grain offering with fine flour mixed with oil.
Grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil as part of the sacrificial system.
